scope.summary: Implement per-face material slots (CG-19, MD Fabric Front/Back/Side Setting): distinct front/back/side PBR material assignment per panel (side = thickness rim when thick mesh is enabled), with back-face texture transform support, extending TailorMaterialAssignment per Section 13.9 §5.
acceptance_criteria: TailorMaterialAssignment extended with optional back_material_id and side_material_id (defaults inherit front); migration additive on tailor_material_assignments.
Viewport renders front/back materials by facing direction (double-sided shading path); thick-mesh side faces (MT-473 thickness extrusion) bind side material.
Exports carry per-face materials where the lane supports it (glTF: doubleSided + separate side-rim primitive; OBJ groups; USD subsets); lane limitations documented in ModelManual.
assign_material MCP tool accepts the face selector.
scope.risk_if_missed: Lined/contrast-back fabrics (satin-back crepe, printed linings, sheer double-face) are unrepresentable with a single material; closeup shots of open jackets/skirt flips expose the wrong face.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; GUI exposure rides the existing Tailor panels and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the Tailor* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.11/13.14.
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long sim/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
